title: THE BELT HIGHLIGHT DROPS NOTHING HIDDEN
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. With the backpack open, walking the highlight down past the last stack moves the gold ring onto the belt row. The backpack stack it left had no ring any more, but Z, Y on a controller, T and Enter still acted on it: pressing Z meaning to drop the Medkit ringed on the belt dropped a hidden backpack item instead (in co-op, a pile your teammate can take), T offered it and Enter equipped it. With the highlight on the belt these keys now say where the highlight is and do nothing, and clicking a backpack tile brings the highlight back into the backpack.
now: With the backpack highlight on the belt, dropping, offering and equipping no longer act on an unmarked backpack item.
